integrity: An analytic proof is supplied; the finite checker is supporting evidence only. Results are not independently audited and no external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime cyclic orders \(p>=7\) and exactly three nonzero entries in each STFT input. Results below \(6p-3\) only; no full higher-support classification or composite-modulus extension. The numerical \(5p-4\) lower bound is previously known; priority of the new inverse and spectrum claims cannot be guaranteed exhaustively.
title: The low-support spectrum and inverse rigidity of three-tap cross-STFTs on prime cycles
